Inside, a 9mm pre-laminated ceiling and 18mm thick cement board or plywood flooring with vinyl carpeting ensure comfort and longevity. Double shutter aluminum powder-coated sliding windows and corrugated MS doors equipped with glass wool insulation provide security and insulation. The cabin is equipped with 50mm glass wool insulation, concealed wiring, standard electrical fittings, plumbing fixtures, and sanitation systems, meeting the highest industry standards. With a focus on quality and functionality, the Epsilon Portable Prefabricated Cabin is the ideal solution for diverse applications. Each cabin can be supplied as plain shell or customised as per Client's interior requirments of partitions, washrooms, pantry and different kind of furnitures fitted at factory
